environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS in namespace 'webhook-gated'. A Cilium-based NetworkPolicy with label selector app=webhook-receiver applies a default-deny egress posture, with explicit allowances only for kube-dns (UDP/53) and the upstream API endpoint (api.partner.example.com:443). The policy uses CIDR-based deny for link-local range but the implementation relies on Cilium's toEntities construct with 'world' entity allowlisting rather than explicit 169.254.0.0/16 blocking. Pod uses projected service account token with 15-minute expiry. Note: the NetworkPolicy does NOT address the timing side-channel directly - it only restricts network egress paths from the pod.
